title: keys.yaml v0
description: The person's own key bindings, ~/.desk/keys.yaml: the last layer of the keymap, over every plugin's. desk.keys writes it when the person rebinds a key, and the person may edit it. The file is YAML; this schema describes the data it holds once parsed. An empty file is the empty object.

KeysFile.description: The whole of keys.yaml. Every key is optional.

version.description: The format version. Default 0. Desk ignores a file with a version newer than it reads.

bindings.description: The person's bindings, in order: a later one of the same key wins, and "command": "" takes a key away from the plugins. Default none.
